web.title: Kitty Awards: Kitty Party Game Rules, How to Play and Twists
web.description: Kitty Awards is a kitty party game where ladies vote fun awards like Selfie Queen, and winners give a 10 second filmy speech. Rules, award ideas, tips and FAQ.
web.intro: Kitty Awards is a kitty party voting game where the host announces fun award titles like "Selfie Queen" or "Sabse Late", and every lady secretly writes on a chit who deserves it. The lady named most wins the award and a dupatta sash, and the lady with the most sashes at the end is the Kitty Superstar. The crazy twist: every winner must give a 10 second filmy acceptance speech, and if she laughs or says "main nahi hoon", the award passes to the lady who nominated her. All you need is paper chits, pens, a bowl and an old dupatta.
materials: A list of 8 fun award titles for the host
One old dupatta to use as the award sash (or one per award)
A phone timer for the 10 second speeches
steps: Before the game, the host writes a list of 8 light, friendly award titles, such as Sabse Late Queen, Selfie Queen, Gossip Ki Rani, Phone Pe Busy, Recipe Ki Dukaan, Best Dressed, Hamesha Hasne Wali and Dance Floor Ki Shaan.
The host announces the first award out loud.
Every lady secretly writes the name of the lady she thinks deserves it on a chit, writes her own name at the bottom as the nominator, folds it and drops it in the bowl. You cannot vote for yourself.
The host counts the chits. The lady named most wins, and the host puts the dupatta sash on her.
The winner stands up and gives a 10 second filmy acceptance speech while someone runs the phone timer.
If the winner laughs during her speech or says "main nahi hoon", the award passes to one of the ladies who nominated her, picked by the host from the chits. Repeat for all 8 awards.
rules: A chit with the voter's own name in the award line is cancelled.
A winner who laughs or denies the award during her speech loses it to one of her nominators.
If two ladies tie, both give a speech and the room decides by clapping.
The lady who ends with the most awards is crowned Kitty Superstar.
variations: Make every acceptance speech include one famous filmy dialogue.
Before taking her award, the winner must do a short ramp walk across the room.
For the last award, "Kitty Ki Jaan", the whole room votes by clapping instead of chits.
tips: Keep every award title kind and funny; avoid anything about weight, looks, money or family problems.
Write the award list on a chart paper so everyone can see what is coming.
Run the timer loudly; the countdown is what makes the speeches funny.
Click a photo of each winner with her sash for the kitty group.

faq.q: How many players do you need for Kitty Awards?
faq.a: It works best with 8 to 20 ladies. With fewer than 8, cut the list to 5 awards so the votes do not tie every time.

faq.q: What do you need to play Kitty Awards?
faq.a: Paper chits, pens, a bowl, a list of award titles and an old dupatta for the sash. A phone timer helps for the speeches.

faq.q: What are some good award ideas for a kitty party?
faq.a: Sabse Late Queen, Selfie Queen, Gossip Ki Rani, Phone Pe Busy, Recipe Ki Dukaan, Best Dressed, Hamesha Hasne Wali and Dance Floor Ki Shaan are all fun and friendly.

faq.q: How do you win Kitty Awards?
faq.a: Get named most by the other ladies, then keep a straight face through your 10 second filmy speech. The lady with the most awards at the end is the Kitty Superstar.

faq.q: Is Kitty Awards a good game for a year end or New Year kitty party?
faq.a: Yes. It is a perfect last kitty of the year game because it celebrates every lady, needs no running around and gives great photos for the group.
